messages:
anita: FYI saw duplicated dedicated reserve jobs when using the Java SDK from the sample app. two reservations created for one user action.
ryan: did you see duplicate requests to the backend or just duplicate resources?
anita: duplicate resources. looking at logs: SDK retried the POST to /dedicated/reservations and backend accepted both. no idempotency-key in header.
matt: which SDK version? retry policy could be too aggressive.
anita: java-sdk 0.9.7. sample app uses default client builder. curl against hosted API (single POST) only creates one reservation. seems SDK retry logic is different from our REST guidance.
ryan: that endpoint is non-idempotent. default retry should not retry POSTs without an Idempotency-Key or only on idempotent-safe errors. 😬
ops-bot: opened RDW-4710: java-sdk-retry-post-no-idempotency duplicates reserved resources. linked logs: https://go/redwood/logs/rdw-4710
matt: assign to @ryan. probable fixes: (A) make SDK not retry non-idempotent methods unless idempotency-key header is present; (B) add automatic idempotency-key generation for POST requests that declare safe-retry in server metadata; (C) add opt-in builder flag to preserve old behavior.
ryan: I can throw a quick patch to change default to (A) for a hotfix 0.9.8. we should also add a warning in client builder docs about non-idempotent POSTs.
docs: please add a note to onboarding/sample-apps: recommend adding Idempotency-Key for operations that create resources (and show how to attach it via SDK).
anita: this is blocking a few onboardings testing Dedicated provision flows. customers saw double charges in staging which is confusing.
matt: long-term: server should advertise which operations it considers retry-safe via model config /openapi extension so SDKs can pick safe defaults. add RDW-4711 for protocol enhancement.
ryan: I'll add unit tests that simulate 500 then success with and without idempotency header, and an e2e smoke in CI that runs the sample app against a simulated flaky backend to ensure no duplicates.
ops-bot: CI ticket created and matrix entry added: private-dedicated-flaky-e2e. RDW-4710 updated.
docs: will update sample-apps README with the Idempotency-Key snippet and an example using UUID v4.
anita: thanks — can we also add a runtime warning if the SDK sees a retry on POST without idempotency-key (maybe just in debug mode)? that would have flagged this earlier.
ryan: good idea, I'll add an opt-in debug logger message. PR will target 0.9.8 (hotfix) and a follow-up for 1.0.0 to implement server-advertised safe-retry behavior.
anita: appreciated. tl;dr: Java SDK retried non-idempotent POSTs by default, caused duplicate reservations; 0.9.8 hotfix to stop retrying those POSTs unless idempotency-key present + docs + CI tests.
